headline: New targets from the owner on Oct 29: Sprint 1 work done by Oct 30, and a guest books a seeded session end to end (home, browse, experience, booking, checkout, confirmation) on the fake payment adapter by Monday Nov 2; no Stripe. The Prototype's 21 units are all live at ramble-sand.vercel.app; the checkout and confirmation stubs the plan listed were never built, so that glue goes first. The deep-review hold is lifted: U-005 and U-014a go into integration now, and the audit's fixes run in their own lane beside the build. The src/lib layout (H-18) is adopted; its seven-PR refactor plan is written. The refit below puts the money core on agents (the owner's call for U-016, U-047a and U-049) and still says December for the confirmation page, because it prices every unit at its estimate with review rounds; agent actuals so far run well under that, which is what a Monday landing depends on.
recommended: Lever 4 too (money core to agents), Dave 12.5 h
